Since the order is still in pending status, we can modify the items in the order. However, please note that any modification to the items can only be done once, and after that, no further modifications or cancellations will be possible. Instead of removing just one item, you would need to proceed with the complete set of items you want to keep.

In your case, if you want to keep only the Bluetooth Speaker and Smartphone (removing the Air Purifier), I can help you modify the order. Here's what the modification would look like:

Original items:
1. Bluetooth Speaker (red) - $315.20
2. Smartphone (black, 128GB) - $1,157.86
3. Air Purifier - $547.55

New items (keeping the same options):
1. Bluetooth Speaker (red) - $315.20
2. Smartphone (black, 128GB) - $1,157.86

This will reduce your total by $547.55, which will be refunded to your original payment method (credit card ending in 7455506).

Would you like to proceed with this modification? Please confirm with a "yes" if you want to move forward, and make sure this is the only modification you need as no further changes will be possible after this.
